title: Open research targets
description: The registered quantities with no estimator, and what would close each one. Generated by scripts/build_catalogue.py through the same reader the library's documentation build uses. Published rather than hidden, because section 4.2 says an unbuilt quantity is an open research target and the honest move is to name it. A `claimed` of false means no catalogue instrument even claims the quantity, which is a different and larger gap than an unbuilt ladder.

provenance.description: Which library this was read from. A libraryVersion below 3.0.0 means the generator ran under the wrong venv and every count is a v2 count; build_catalogue.py refuses that case rather than emitting it. skippedModules names the modules a missing optional extra kept out of the walk, and it is not decoration: an estimator registers when its module imports, so a skipped module makes its quantities read as open. A reader who is told which extras were missing can tell 'nobody has built this' from 'this build could not see it'.
